LanguageData.WF_Tooltip: Filter final products in the Add bill list by source mod and, for apparel, by layer and nudist compatibility.
LanguageData.WF_Explanation: Choose the final product’s source mod, apparel layer or nudist compatibility. Filters apply together.
LanguageData.WF_ExplanationModOnly: Choose the source mod of this workshop’s final products.
LanguageData.WF_NudistTip: Checked: only show apparel compatible with nudity under the game’s rules (it does not count as clothing for nudity, or covers neither torso nor legs). Unchecked: no nudity restriction.
